name: Flight 3
summary: Ship 28 completed its full-duration ascent burn and reached its planned trajectory for the first time, then opened and closed its payload door and performed an in-space propellant transfer demonstration. The planned in-space Raptor relight was skipped after the ship lost roll control, which SpaceX traced to stuck roll-control valves, and the ship broke up during reentry over the Indian Ocean about 49 minutes after launch. Booster 10 lost engines during boostback to LOX filter blockages and was destroyed at about 462 m during its landing burn over the Gulf of Mexico.
highlights: First full-duration ship burn to the planned trajectory
Raptor relight skipped after loss of roll control
Ship lost during reentry around 65 km altitude
Booster lit only 2 of 13 engines for its landing burn

objectives.label: In-space Raptor relight
objectives.note: Skipped due to loss of roll control.

objectives.label: Booster landing burn and Gulf splashdown

boosterFate: Lost at about 462 m altitude during the landing burn over the Gulf of Mexico (telemetry lost around T+7:01).
shipFate: Broke up during reentry over the Indian Ocean; telemetry lost at T+49:41 at about 65 km.
